ask: can u make a poll for this so everyone picks their spot
sentence: Each person picks one position for each game night from a limited list, with a cap on total players per night and on certain positions, and can release or change their pick.
use_when: Everyone in a group needs to pick a position or role for a game night
A pickup game or team event has a fixed number of spots per night
Some roles have a smaller limit than others, like two quarterbacks
You want to see who has not picked a spot yet
dont_use_when: A simple yes or no vote or a single-choice poll is enough
Teams need to be split automatically or at random
People need to pick a time or date instead of a role
Scores or results need to be tracked
